verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical and share the same serious flaws. The headline is a one-word-per-line tower that eats about 60% of the height. The price cards are shrunk to thumbnails with unreadable labels, and they are out of order: Yearly, the featured plan, has moved from the middle to last. The subhead now sits below the CTA, and the fine print is crammed at the bottom. The only difference is the logo: A's is larger and readable, while B's is a tiny centred wordmark that weakens the brand, so A is marginally better.
